title: Cable Rear Delt Fly
summary: A crossed-cable reverse fly that keeps tension on the rear delts through the full arc.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for rear delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and cross the cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Return slowly until your hands cross.

form_cues.cue: Sweep the arms back and out
Pull wide, not back. Think of moving your hands apart.

mistakes.text: Pinching the shoulder blades hard to pull with the back.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Less constant tension.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
